title: WaPay Money Map
vatNote: WaPay is not VAT-registered (switch: WAPAY_VAT_REGISTERED). Every supplier price quoted excluding VAT costs WaPay 1.15 times the quoted number and the VAT cannot be recovered. WaPay charges no VAT on its own fees today.

statusVocabulary.SIGNED: In an executed contract, or on a supplier rate card WaPay is actually charged against.
statusVocabulary.LIVE: In code and charged to customers today, on a rail that is on in production.
statusVocabulary.ASSUMED: Used in code or in a guide without a contract or a recorded founder decision.
statusVocabulary.PROPOSED: A recommendation, a supplier offer, or a recorded decision not yet charged (rail off) or not yet agreed by the counterparty.
statusVocabulary.UNKNOWN: Asked of the supplier or never asked; no answer on file.

in.title: Money in
in.blurb: How value enters a wallet: card and EFT deposits, voucher loads, and the rails not yet built.

out.title: Money out
out.blurb: Withdrawals on OTT's pay-out rail and Pay@: what OTT charges, what the customer pays, what is left. The rail in depth, the benchmark and the +R2 options are in docs/PAYOUT_COMMERCIALS.md (payouts thread, commit 24d07f8, 2026-10-04).

vend.title: Vending
vend.blurb: Products bought from the balance: the customer pays face, WaPay earns a commission or pays a fee to the issuer.

paid.title: Getting paid
paid.blurb: Please Pay Me links: the payer always pays the displayed amount; the receiver carries the card fee.

send.title: Sending
send.blurb: Person to person: free inside WaPay, a R3 service fee on a voucher to a non-member.

biz.title: Business
biz.blurb: WaPay for Business: the same rails under a business account, plus the pay-out and disbursement ideas on file.

fixed.title: Costs that are not per transaction
fixed.blurb: Retainers and per-message costs that sit under every row above.

rows.notes: A Nedbank or ABSA cash send that is never collected is reversed at R10 ex VAT (R11.50) and the ledger books nothing on reversal, so an uncollected R50 cash send that earned R6.36 ends R5.14 down. PAYOUT_COMMERCIALS.md section 6 assumes 5% uncollected until the first month of real cash sends, which takes the average cash margin at R50 from R6.36 to about R5.78.
